cover_letter:
Dear Spott team,

I'm excited to apply for the Product Designer position. Your vision of an AI-native recruitment platform that replaces legacy software aligns with my passion for building intuitive, scalable digital products. Although my background is in digital marketing, my work has always been product-focused: I design and build websites, create user flows, and optimize for both human and AI search engines.

At Episto, I own the full cycle of client website design and development—from wireframing in WordPress to publishing and iterating based on analytics. I collaborate with clients to understand their needs and translate them into clean, responsive interfaces. On my personal project, mirook.com, I designed the entire UX for a youth chess champion's site, implemented structured data, and ran iterative audits to improve search health. This required rapid prototyping, attention to visual detail, and a deep understanding of how users interact with content.

I'm proficient with Figma and have hands-on experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. I'm eager to expand my research toolkit with platforms like Maze or Dovetail. My time in warehouse logistics taught me resilience and adaptability in high-pressure, fast-changing environments—skills I bring to every project.

I'm drawn to Spott's ambition and the chance to shape a product from the ground up. I'd love to contribute my design sensibility and technical foundation to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
